title: VeloraOS 1.10.49 - Licence Soft Lock
releaseNotes: Soft-locks licensed features when a licence is confirmed revoked, expired, inactive or otherwise no longer entitled.
Keeps sign-in, licence activation/recheck, profile/account recovery, settings, health and read-only chat retrieval available.
Blocks AI generation, Coding, Image Intelligence, Web Intelligence and model-management actions while locked.
Preserves the existing 72-hour offline grace behaviour for temporary licensing-service outages.
Preserves all local user data, installed Ollama models, device identity and TLS/CA material.
Restores full access immediately after a valid licence is activated.
